answer: Require every identity to lock 120 POA for 21 days and pass a grove of three independent peer juries over three epochs before rewards vest. A jury checks on-chain funding history and rejects shared wallets, so identities funded from one source pay a bond multiplier of 1.6 for each additional identity, reaching the zenith of cost at the tenth clone. Each identity also completes a sequential delay task anchored to a basalt-hard checkpoint that takes six hours and cannot be parallelized, so ten fakes cost ten bonds plus sixty hours, while honest users pay once.
